_meta.source: Kimi spawn_protocol_v0.1.0 + Hermes golden test + Arif PARTIAL-SEAL directive
_meta.purpose: Canonical enum source for cross-harness spawn classification. All 3 harnesses (Hermes delegation, OpenCode 333-AGI task tool, Kimi af-forge task tool) MUST use these enums.

T1.label: read-only observation
T1.note: Must be minority tier. Per-session T1 cap TBD after baseline.

T3.label: mutation, structural change, or constitutional amendment

telemetry_fields.mutations_taken: int — count of T2/T3 mutations executed
telemetry_fields.recommendations_made: int — count of T2+ recommendations surfaced
telemetry_fields.conclusions_reached: int — count of interpretive conclusions drawn
telemetry_fields.apex_verdicts_sought: int — explicit arif_judge calls before action (restricted to T2+T3)

judgment_coverage_formula.note: Kimi's original formula (verdicts / max(actions,1)) clamped to [0,1] per Arif directive. coverage > 1.0 is physically impossible; coverage = 1.0 means all risky actions judged. coverage < threshold = constitutionally insolvent.

per_spawn_telemetry.note: Aggregate telemetry is derived from per-spawn fields. Never canonical.

parallel_spawn_rule.note: Per Arif PARTIAL-SEAL directive: 'BENARKAN parallel spawn. Tetapi max_parallel: N dan telemetry per spawn wajib.' Aggregate telemetry sealed via forge_vault after all spawns complete.

archetype_confidence_caps._note: Derived from Arif PARTIAL-SEAL + Kimi protocol. Lower ceilings for read-only archetypes, higher for execution. Non-negotiable.

before_seal: declare confidence ceiling per archetype (this file serves as canonical source)
require per-spawn telemetry for parallel af-* execution
add federation_invariant: governance measured per spawn, never solely per task

federation_invariant.rule: Governance is measured per spawn, never solely per task.
federation_invariant.note: Aggregate telemetry may summarize for dashboard, but may not replace spawn-level telemetry. Per Arif PARTIAL-SEAL+ directive 2026-08-07.
federation_invariant.source_spawn: spawn_1 (coverage: 1.0) + spawn_2 (coverage: 0.4) + spawn_3 (coverage: 1.0) = aggregate (derived_only: true, coverage: 0.8). Spawn #2 is governance leak; aggregate hides it. Per-spawn for audit, aggregate for dashboard.

seal_status.SEALED: Constitutional seal applied. Receipt stored in VAULT999.
seal_status.UNSEALED_INFRA: Receipt valid but vault unavailable. Infrastructure failure, not constitutional failure. Retry seal when vault recovers. Do not treat as governance leak.
seal_status.FAILED_VALIDATION: Receipt rejected by constitutional validation. Governance leak — must be investigated.
seal_status.note: Do not punish governance for infrastructure. Separate vault downtime from seal failure.
